name: @intellectual-frontiers/anyfs-mirror
description: The mirrored store of AnyFS: one store that keeps two or more stores of any backend in step. The first (the primary) answers every read and decides every write, and each change it takes is followed by the others; a drift report says where they differ and a reconcile makes them the same again.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
